title: Host rules and mod settings
summary: Run the server, set its rules and pick the MCM settings your players get.

sections.heading: While the server runs
steps: Save game keeps the server up and players connected. Stop server and Restart save first.
Last good save puts back the newest save from before your hero lost their party and starts again.
Kick player, Ban player and Unban player are on the Dashboard.

sections.heading: Story choices
steps: Realm of Thrones asks questions during its story, like the sieges. Every player sees them with a timer.
The first player to answer decides for everyone. If nobody answers in 60 seconds, the default goes ahead.
The world waits for the answer.

sections.heading: Server rules
steps: On the Settings page, open the server rules part (its heading starts with Advanced). The defaults work without setup.
Pause the game while a player joins is on. It puts your speed back when they are on the map.
Freeze the skill XP of offline players is on. Coop already freezes their gold and food.
Unstuck for players picks who may use coop.unstuck.
Protect player kingdoms from AI wars picks when AI kingdoms may start a war with a kingdom players are in.
Click Save settings to keep a change.

sections.heading: Mod settings for players
steps: Players who join with a Coodsz launcher use your MCM settings for the session, so every PC runs the mods the same way. Their own files are never changed.
On the Settings page, open the mod settings for players part (its heading starts with Advanced), pick a mod, change a value and click Save.
Players get the new value within a few seconds, with no restart.
No mod settings yet? Click Import mod settings and pick the .zip a player sent you, or set the mods up in MCM in your own game.
Back to this PC's values puts a mod back to the values MCM saved in your own game.
sections.tip: Settings a mod keeps per campaign are saved in the world and can only be changed in game.
